# Robin Bedtime Stories for Kids

> iPhone and iPad app with 35 original, narrated bedtime stories for children aged 6–10. Read-along text highlighted line by line, sleep timer, offline playback, plays with the screen locked. No ads, no accounts, no tracking. Free download with 8 free stories; one-time $4.99 unlock for all 35 (no subscription). Made by Cowork Game Studio.

- [About the app and full story list](https://robinbedtime.coworkgamestudio.com/bedtime-stories/)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6777299933)
- [Support](https://robinbedtime.coworkgamestudio.com/support/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://robinbedtime.coworkgamestudio.com/)
